The model’s assumption about cube structure led to an incorrect baseline (6 total red faces) and thus a wrong final count.

errors.description: The model failed to recognize that the hidden faces are not merely the complement of visible ones in a fixed 3+3 split per cube — it ignored the actual spatial configuration (IN, LEFT, UP faces hidden per the camera angle) and instead assumed that any non-visible face is hidden without verifying which specific faces are occluded. This led to misattribution of which red faces are actually hidden, especially in cubes where red appears on multiple faces (e.g., Cube 3 has red on both front and top — but top is visible, front is not — yet model only counted top as visible and assumed the rest are hidden without checking orientation).
